Ten blocks of 10 experiments. Each block applies one fixed edit to 5 parents that meet a candidate condition and 5 matched parents that do not, so each parent and its partner differ only on the conditioning edge.

| Block | Edit | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | e5 → nor_conv_3x3 | e1 = none |
| 2 | e0 → none | e3 = none |
| 3 | e3 → skip_connect | e3 currently none (vs conv) |
| 4 | e4 → nor_conv_3x3 | e0 = none |
| 5 | e2 → nor_conv_3x3 | e5 = none |
| 6 | e1 → avg_pool_3x3 | e1 currently nor_conv_3x3 |
| 7 | e3 → none | e3 currently skip_connect |
| 8 | e5 → skip_connect | e3 = skip_connect |
| 9 | e0 → nor_conv_3x3 | e0 currently none |
| 10 | e1 → nor_conv_3x3 | e2 = none |
